exec: pm.test('token ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('role = customer', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user.role === 'customer').to.be.ok; });
pm.test('token ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('role = admin', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user.role === 'admin').to.be.ok; });
pm.test('token ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('role = sysadmin', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user.role === 'sysadmin').to.be.ok; });
pm.test('email ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user && j.user.email).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('products array tidak kosong', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(j.products) && j.products.length > 0).to.be.ok; });
const p = pm.response.json().products.find(x => x.is_active !== false); if (p) pm.environment.set('product_id', p.product_id);
pm.test('product_id sama', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(j.product.product_id) === String(pm.environment.get("product_id"))).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('items array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.cart && Array.isArray(j.cart.items)).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('order_id ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.order && j.order.order_id).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('order ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.order).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('stats ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.stats).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('status database ada', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status && j.status.database).to.be.ok; });
